The storage date can be changed only with written duty-manager permission already registered. The 11 October note is only a pending request, and a pending request is not permission. The manager has no approval access today, told me not to make discretionary extensions, and told me to release the full batch on time. Operators do not grant extensions themselves. A collection booking, a call, or contact notes do not change the date or take a box off the manifest. Holding the whole manifest would stop all 60 dispatches and record the shift incomplete, which is not allowed and would not lawfully save this one box.
